quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: One, two... Mmm, three...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Hmm, hmm... One, two...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon, sound the weirdo alarm!

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Ah, if you ask me, the only weirdos round here are you outlanders... Ho... hoho... This sure isn't the type of place you'd expect to see outlanders...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this some kind of... forbidden place? Or sacred place?

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Nope, just some place I discovered, completely by chance... a place of buried treasure. Mmm, well come on then you two, huddle up. Can you hear it? This very special rock before you... this is... the "Treasure Stone"...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: The low humming noise it makes rises and falls, almost like... the sound of breathing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's only breathing... What's so hard about that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A rock... can breathe?

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: Yes, and not only that... If you press your ear against it, you can hear a beat too... even the sound of rock grinding against rock beneath its coarse surface...

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: Hehe.. Hoho... Such wonderful sounds.

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: And, and... If you feed it small rocks, it'll give you even better, shinier rocks in return...

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: Aaaah, simply incredible, is it not? Look at these gemstones... look! One, two...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so that's what you were doing when we came over just now, counting gems...

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: Yes, and I can tell that after gobbling up all these rocks, the Treasure Stone has become even stronger, even more powerful than before...

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: This must be... a miracle! Ah, my Treasure Stone... my precious...

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: Heh, hehe... I never expected outsiders like you to believe me. Nobody would believe it... before they'd tried it themselves.

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: I myself discovered it by pure chance after placing some ore that I'd collected on the Treasure Stone's edge...

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: Speaking of which... Why don't you give it a try? Seeing is believing, after all!

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: It just so happens that it's already eaten all the rocks around here though. I need to find it some new ones... but I can't go looking myself...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm... Why not?

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: Well of course, someone has to stay here and look after the Treasure Stone, don't they? C—Can you imagine what would happen if it went into hiding underground while I was away... What would I do then!?

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: I've stood guard here for such a long time now... all the rocks I had on me, I've already fed them to the Stone...

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: G—Go, find me some new ones, and I'll prove it. I'll f—feed them to it before your very eyes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, sounds like a classic con-artist's pitch...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Wanna give it a try?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, if they're just rocks...

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: Hehe, then it's a deal! You go pick some rocks, give them to me, and I'll feed them to the Treasure Stone... and I guarantee you it'll make some even better ones...

choices.text: For real? Why does it sound like some kind of scam...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, what's so amazing about being able to breathe... Wait, why are we even talking about this?

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Mmm... Patience, patience is the key. When things have quietened down, I'll feed these to the Treasure Stone...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Just give it some time, hehe, and it'll produce some even better rocks... Hehe... One, two...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, something actually did grow out of it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All hail the Treasure St... Wait a sec, you didn't just place those on top, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: ...Heh, hehe, do I look like I would do something so foolish?

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Thanks to those rocks you brought, the Treasure Stone is even more energetic than it was before. Oh, can't you hear it...?

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: That sound, pulsing as the magma that flows beneath the earth, is just like... Ah, like a heartbeat...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: I knew it... I knew I just had to find some other rocks to feed it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... Paimon's not hearing anything...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Can you hear it, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Just sounds like any old rock to me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right...

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: Hehe, outlanders... Or perhaps I should say, distinguished guests from afar...

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: If you are able, please find me some more rocks... better, more beautiful ones... The power of the Treasure Stone will not disappoint you...

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: I can feel it in my bones... I can tell that this will be good for it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why does it feel like we're falling deeper and deeper into a trap...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: If it means we'll be able to get our hands on some better rocks...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's definitely worth a try...

response.speaker: Qispi
response.text: Hehe, great! So this time, you'll pick some even better rocks than before, and you'll give them straight to me... And with even better rocks to feed upon, the Treasure Stone will surely become more powerful than ever...

choices.text: Can't you hear it, hear how it screeches? "Whooooooaaaa"!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No way! You're just trying to scare Paimon again!

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Mmm... Patience, patience is the key. When things have quietened down, I'll feed these to the Treasure Stone... Hehe, thanks for bringing these rocks...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: C'mon Treasure Stone, time to make some even better rocks, hehe... One, two...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Would you look at that, it's done it again, and they're even better than before... Still feels pretty magical, despite the fact that we've seen it twice now...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Heh, hehe, wary outlanders...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Now that you have seen it for yourselves, you can no longer deny the greatness of the Treasure Stone.

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Aaah, and thanks to the rocks you have brought, the Treasure Stone's power has grown even stronger...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Who knows how powerful it might become...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, even Paimon's starting to feel curious...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All you have to do is feed it rocks and it creates even better ones for you... But how does that even work? Why don't we crack it open and take a look inside?

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: H—How could you even suggest such a thing? No, I shall not allow it!

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: If you're seriously planning on cracking it open... You'll have to step over my cold, dead body first...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, that was just a throwaway comment...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Hmph, well considering that you brought it all those rocks before, I'll let your impudence slide... But just this once...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: O—Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: I can feel it, hehe! If I can just feed the Treasure Stone some even higher quality rocks, I'm certain it'll produce something incredible...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Traveler from afar, a foreign merchant once told me of a special type of stone from the desert that holds extraordinary power in store...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Its name... Yes, its name is Trishiraite. If you could but bring me it so I could feed it to the Treasure Stone...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: I'm certain, beyond a doubt...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm... What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's give it a try!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's feeling pretty curious to see what will happen too, that's for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: If you really can get your hands on Trishiraite... A single chunk should suffice...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Ah, my Treasure Stone... Finally... The time has come...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Mmm... I'll feed these to the Treasure Stone once things have quieted down...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Just give it some time, hehe, and it'll produce some even better rocks... Hehe... One, two...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Mmm... I'll feed the rocks you brought to the Treasure Stone once things have quieted down... Haha, and what marvelous rocks these are...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Just give it some time, hehe, and it'll produce some even better rocks... Hehe... One, two...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Haha... So this is Trishiraite, a stone that does not grow within the borders of Natlan. When the Treasure Stone consumes it, it will surely be able to... absorb its power.

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Ah, how I long to know, how I yearn to know, my Treasure Stone...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: What's up? Hehe, just like I said before... You go find some rocks, hand them over to me, and I'll feed them to the Treasure Stone. I guarantee you it'll make some even better ones...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: Hehe, great! So this time, you'll pick some even better rocks than before, and you'll give them straight to me... And with even better rocks to feed upon, the Treasure Stone will surely become more powerful than ever...

dialogues.speaker: Qispi
dialogues.text: So, did you find the Trishiraite? Give it to me, quick...
